css: .receipt-pdf { font-family: Georgia, serif; color: #222; padding: 0 } .receipt-header { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#3a9e8a,#4ABFAB,#6BB8D4); color: #fff; padding: 2rem; text-align: center } .receipt-body { padding: 2rem } .receipt-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 1rem 0 } .receipt-table th, .receipt-table td { padding: .5rem; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee } .receipt-total { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3a9e8a; text-align: right; padding: 1rem } .compliance { font-size: .85rem; color: #555; border-top: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 1rem; font-style: italic }
